spec_match.rationale: Exercises the exact constructor option and readonly attribute, including the spec's synchronous downgrade rule ([[CongestionControl]] set at construction, non-default requests falling back to 'default' when no optimizing algorithm exists).

interactive.rationale: One button constructs three real sessions (one per enum value) against a dead endpoint and tabulates each attribute readback with its meaning.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises three constructions, immediate readback and the downgrade twist; the page delivers exactly those.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers no-WebTransport, attribute-absent (option ignored as unknown member — explicitly not counted as support), honored, downgraded, and unexpected-value rows.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5180947573112832 and the option's spec section; the feature index adds the attribute section, RFC 9002 §7 and the explainer.

conformance.rationale: New 6-assertion suite covers prototype placement, readonly accessor shape, construction-time slot, default identity, honored-or-downgraded rule and the invalid-enum TypeError; honest fails on this pre-158 container.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): run clicked; all three rows filled with attribute-absent and the explicit ignored-member-is-not-support wording; sessions were real constructor calls; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow; desktop screenshot read. Partial: honored/downgraded readbacks need a 158+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: wt-cc-readback-ran asserts the three rows; ready/closed promises are claimed so no unhandled rejections.

design_system.rationale: Honored/downgraded/missing cell inks (emerald/blue/rose) on bg-paper at AA, always paired with meaning text.

accessibility.rationale: Native button, caption + scoped-header table in an overflow wrapper, verdict is aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Record this platform's honored/downgraded pattern on Chrome 158+
openQuestions.detail: On a 158+ build, run the three constructions and record which non-default preferences read back honored versus downgraded on this OS, and confirm the conformance suite reaches 6/6.

guidanceConsulted.query: result table three states accessible not color alone
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: State must be conveyed by text as well as color; use scoped headers and captions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each readback cell pairs its color with the literal value and a meaning column; the table has caption and th scope.

summary: Three real constructions, immediate congestionControl readback and the construction-time downgrade rule. Driven on headless Chromium 141 with experimental flags (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): honest attribute-absent rows, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
